episodeTitle: 《娱乐至死》全书深读：当所有认真的事都必须长得像娱乐

styleBible.promptPrefix: Loose, sketchy hand-drawn editorial illustration on clean white paper, quickly scrawled with wax crayons, dry colored pencils, and broad felt markers in the spirit of sharp newspaper op-ed comics and intellectual magazine column art. Linework: fast, gestural, sketchy black ink and dark crayon strokes with uneven weight, hurried cross-hatching, loose overlapping construction lines, and raw broken contours. Color & texture: vivid direct editorial hues (red, yellow, cobalt blue, orange, violet, green) applied in rapid, grainy crayon shading and flat marker swipes that casually bleed past the contours, leaving raw paper grain and uncolored white gaps visible. Figures & objects: adult editorial caricature and witty visual shorthand—lean, expressive silhouettes, sharp understated posture, wry observant expressions, and stylized everyday objects distilled to a few confident, hurried strokes. Composition: open white-paper editorial layout with clear visual hierarchy, generous breathing space, and sparse scrawled directional arrows or crisp graphic marks that anchor the concept.
styleBible.promptSuffix: Texture finish: raw analog sketchbook immediacy, fast loose hand-scrawled energy, dry wax-crayon grain, and flat marker paper tooth. Clean pure white background, wordless editorial visual storytelling.

scenes.imagePrompt: A sharp editorial satire of a 1983 television panel show after a nuclear-war film: five suited intellectuals and statesmen sit in a stiff row under glaring studio spotlights as if on a beauty-pageant stage, each isolated under a tiny ticking hourglass with zero eye contact or debate, while floating applause bursts and showbiz confetti drift across the studio floor.

overlay.quoteZh: 文化重心从印刷之都纽约转向娱乐之都拉斯维加斯。

scenes.imagePrompt: Split editorial sketch on white paper: on the left, a frustrated thinker crouches by a small campfire trying to send complex philosophical diagrams through rising black smoke puffs that immediately scatter in the wind; on the right, a giant sketchy mechanical clock slices a yellow sunbeam into rigid numbered wedges and coins.

overlay.chapterTag: 第 1 章 · 媒介即隐喻

scenes.imagePrompt: Wry university dissertation defense sketch: a nervous graduate student gestures toward his ear while pointing to spoken airwaves, facing three stern professors behind a heavy stack of red-stamped printed books; in the upper margin, a wry sketchy horse grins showing its teeth beside an ancient Greek scroll.

overlay.chapterTag: 第 2 章 · 媒介即认识论
overlay.headline: 博士口试脚注与亚里士多德数马牙：真理要挑外衣穿

overlay.chapterTag: 第 1–2 章 · 核心原理与三道防线
overlay.quoteZh: 你根本不可能用烟雾来表现哲学，它的形式已经排除了它的内容。
overlay.quoteEn: You cannot use smoke to do philosophy. Its form excludes the content.
overlay.quoteSource: 《娱乐至死》第 1 章 · 媒介形式决定话语形态

overlay.quoteZh: 在印刷机主宰的时代，普通农夫与工匠曾能消化持续数小时的书面逻辑交锋。

scenes.imagePrompt: Dynamic editorial sketch of an 18th-century wooden printing press cranking out crisp pamphlets that flutter across the page into the hands of everyday artisans, dockworkers, and farmers walking down a colonial street, absorbed in dense pages, while a tiny classical lyre fades at the corner.

overlay.headline: 《常识》狂销数十万册与 3000 座“学园运动”演讲厅

scenes.imagePrompt: Loose newspaper-style sketch of the 1854 Peoria outdoor debate: tall lean Abraham Lincoln in a stovepipe silhouette and stocky Stephen Douglas stand on a timber platform exchanging sharp logical arguments across a packed crowd of attentive farmers and townsfolk, with a sketchy seven-hour clock arc sweeping overhead from afternoon sun to evening moon.

scenes.imagePrompt: Sketchy editorial diagram of 1844 telegraph poles and frantic black wires racing far ahead of a puffing steam locomotive across continents and ocean waves, with dozens of tiny disconnected paper snippets, exclamation marks, and trivia bubbles dangling randomly along the buzzing wire.

overlay.chapterTag: 第 5 章 · 1844 莫尔斯电报

overlay.chapterTag: 第 5 章 · 银版照相术与“伪语境”
overlay.headline: 孤立的图像没有逻辑命题，新闻退化为填字游戏的消遣

overlay.quoteZh: 当电视成为主导认识论，严肃机构不得不主动按表演逻辑改写自己。

scenes.imagePrompt: Sharp op-ed cartoon sketch of a polished TV news anchor flashing a rehearsed grin behind a desk; the backdrop screen is slashed diagonally by a jagged red lightning bolt—one half shows somber smoky crisis silhouettes, the other half bursts into a cheerful yellow weather sun, sports trophy, and floating musical jingle notes.

overlay.chapterTag: 第 7 章 · “好……现在”新闻语法
overlay.headline: 45 秒灾难后瞬间切入彩蛋与广告，前后矛盾不再重要

scenes.imagePrompt: Wry editorial sketch of a living room seen from over the shoulder: a relaxed viewer slumped on a couch holding a snack bag in one hand and a TV remote in the other, watching a charismatic television preacher standing under dazzling neon show-stage spotlights framed by rising ratings charts and coin symbols.

overlay.chapterTag: 第 8 章 · 42 小时电子教堂观察
overlay.headline: 危险不在于宗教成了电视内容，而在于电视成了宗教内容

overlay.headline: 从 1985 三大广播网到今天的算法短视频瀑布流

overlay.chapterTag: 全书终极核心命题
overlay.quoteZh: 文化灭亡不必等待强权禁书与真理部的暴政，只要公共话语心甘情愿地按娱乐业逻辑自我改写，人就会在毫无痛感的笑声中丧失严肃思考与历史记忆的能力。
overlay.quoteSource: 尼尔·波兹曼《娱乐至死》全书收束
